Got this for $2.39, normal price $5.99. I'm giving it a tentative thumbs-down, and I wish that Steam allowed you to rate a game based on 1-5 instead of the polarity of Yes/No... This game is very cheap, so maybe it's worth it for some folks as a chill afternoon time-waster. But understand that it's not a game with great replay value, innovation, or engagement, so for my taste, I could only recommend it when its on sale. It's very simplistic, and requires very little thought from you. You roll and draw for upgrades each Wave until Wave 30. I only have two characters left to unlock, and I can get to Wave 30 on all of them standing still. (Movement Speed and Dodge is an upgrade, but it is NULL since you DON'T HAVE TO MOVE AT ALL.) The gameplay is very shallow compared to the original AND less costly inspiration of Vampire Survivors -- It doesn't have meaningful build/weapon variety, only three types of enemies that all have the same melee attack pattern, and only one map. (Which is a circular moon with NOT much running room at all maybe around a 16x16 running space if your mouse is 1 tile. Again I didn't have to spend any time walking.) It's a cute game. Best part of it are the adorable mice. (I REALLY want to like this game for the mice alone!) But it doesn't encourage me to come back. It doesn't seem worth it to unlock all the mice, since each specializes in a damage/skill, and some damage types are inherently just worst than the others. Curse, Poison, and Star are slow compared to good ole high firing rate + crit damage + arrows/lightning for support, and when your gameplay is based on enemies encroaching on you in a tiny area, you want things done as fast as possible. I think the devs should make the classes more distinct... encourage the player to do different playstyles. Right now, most of the classes work under the same strategy, which makes it really boring.

Rocket rats is great... as a demo. The art, music, and sound design are fun, the concept works, and it feels good mechanically. The problem is that past the initial 20 mins of figuring out how everything works, there's very little content. The map doesn't change, there are only a few enemies, and there are no bosses. Once you reach the final wave, the game just loops. After about an hour and a half of playtime, I felt I'd seen 90% of what the game had to offer. Also, as others have noticed, once your build comes online you generally don't even have to move around the small, circular map, and in that sense this just becomes an idle game. That's fine if it's what you're looking for, but Rocket Rats doesn't really live up to other Bullet Hell or Survivors-style games. If this were a new game, in Early Access, or a demo, I'd be less critical, but the developer has released a second game and announced a third since the release of Rocket Rats so I doubt it will ever get changed or updated. If you get it on sale for like $2, maybe that would be worth it, but there are plenty of excellent, full-fledged games you can get for under $5 that are a better use of your time.

The RNG in this game will absolutely destroy you. Need one, last upgrade to get an achievement or, y'know, not die? LoL nope! Please enjoy this selection of level one garbage that won't help in the slightest. Huge group of enemies right in front of you that you could probably one shot? HAHA NO! You're gonna focus your fire exclusively on single, isolated enemies that are at full health. I mean, what else would you do? You'd think the RNG constantly screwing you over would be par for the course with a game like this and, that's very true. However, you will spend HOURS trying to get the last upgrade for an item and then get it as a fluke on your next run. Most games have a sort of banish feature to deal with this and, I understand why that is now. Like, omg, I cannot overstate how bad the RNG is in this game. Regardless, it is still well worth the asking price. Rocket Rats is short lived but, very fun and, is a very interesting take on the horde survival genre. Just be prepared to restart your runs a lot. :)

玩了好几天，一直在用各种方式打99波，发现这个游戏还是有很多问题： 一、技能描述问题， 1）汉化错误，暴击5级和暴击7级的翻译肯定是错的。 2）描述不严谨和缺失，伤害提升100%在这里指的不是翻倍，而是提升一倍基础伤害的数值。各种武器的基础伤害值，星弹的射速，子弹击退率，这种都没有标出来，要研究，多花几倍时间肯定行，但我不想去一点点推敲了，作者能补上最好。 二、99波无尽的设置问题 第99波，小怪的生命值是5000倍，速度是10倍，数值过于变态，其他毒素技能触发的前提都是机枪攻击，这导致想过99波主要就只有一种打法思路了，就是临时4次无限弹药+暴击5级质变加子弹+其他技能补充。再补点击退和穿透就行了，非常单调. 星际盟友+闪电+箭矢的三联合套路也不错，两种视频我都发了。 总得来说就是个不错的小游戏，但是前期的体验不好，后期的体验也不好。就适合玩一半，抄抄作业，然后扔到一边

I really really wish I could recommend this game, but I can't. The concept is really cool, the pixel art is beautiful, but at the end of the day there just isn't anything here. If you're going to call your game a survivers-like than you're setting yourself up for that comparison, and this is way below Vampire Survivors. There are literally three enemy types. The levels are all just a small moon in different colors depending on the rat, and the upgrades are so few. There are no other maps, nothing cool to discover, just... A moon and three enemy types with a small handful of upgrades. This game is $1 more then vampire survivers and has vastly less content. I really disliked how permanent upgrades worked. You could only active one at a time across three rows. I've never seen such an arbitrary limitation in a game like this. I can understand the characters having that limitation, but not the incremental upgrades. Really bizarre and annoying. When I unlocked the soldier and upgraded it all the way, the game was done. I literally stood in one place and didn't move. Eventually, after like an hour of just setting the game aside and letting it go, the entire screen was filled with the ammo clip so that I could barely see what was going on, and nothing could get close to me. It just kept counting up, 30+50, 30+60, etc, because 30 is when you get the last upgrade. After that I knew there was nothing else to do. On the bright side, it did make me want to play vampire survivers again, so I'm off to do that!

[h1][b]鼠鼠登月记：世界杯好伴侣[/b][/h1] [b]“单玩这游戏有点无聊，单看世界杯也会犯困，两个一起却负负得正！”[/b] “无聊”其实是幸存者类游戏的通病，主要是没什么操作空间，作为开山鼻祖的[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794680/Vampire_Survivors/]吸血鬼幸存者[/url]也让我玩睡着好几回。而本作更是精简，把鼠鼠围在一小块地方，连走位都不需要有，自动攻击着四面八方撞来的星星球球，玩家只要时不时选一下升级即可。它就像吸血鬼幸存者的缩影，如果不喜欢它的话，吸血鬼应该也是玩不下去的。不过它们都能切出后不暂停，游戏看球两不误！ 我很喜欢它的数值，给得非常[b]慷慨[/b]！比如说升一级换弹速度就能加快45%，升一级伤害就是增加30%，比有些游戏的10%，15%宽裕很多。每次升级体验提升一大截，非常满意！ 其次音效和动画效果，以及画风都让人满意。作为小体量游戏，寿命3小时左右，却并没有糊弄人的意思。 看样子最受人诟病的是技能树哪怕全点满之后也只能选一个分支来进行游戏。 但是你要这么想啊，它一条技能树就相当于一个角色嘛，比如玩毒点左边，玩诅咒就点右边；分叉点左边，暴击点右边。不同的技能树选法，确确实实提供了每次游戏不一样的体验。不是说非要换个模型才是换个角色的，相比之下，吸血鬼幸存者意义不明地角色一堆，就是一个主动武器，一个被动效果的区别，箱子里开出来带谁身上都是带。 再者就是它毫无操作空间可言，前期怪少不用走位，后期怪多没法走位[spoiler]甚至有个30波一步不动的成就[/spoiler]。玩家要做的就只是时不时选个升级，多少有点没参与感。反正我是建议边看球边玩！ [h1]题外话[/h1] 作为不懂球，不赌球，平时也不看球，每隔四年学习一下什么叫越位，学完就忘的纯世界杯乐子人。 前几天从日本踢巴西之后开始看，结果至今我支持的球队[b]无一幸免[/b] _(___°π°œ)_ 先是诶这个国旗头回见，那我支持它吧的波黑倒了； 然后是鼠鼠的归宿澳大利亚，挂嘞； 接着这个名字有点意思的佛得角输了； 高温不下的加拿大也凉了； 就在刚刚，一个因为C罗跟我高中同桌长很像所以支持的葡萄牙，和全世界我最喜欢的公司Valve所在的美国，纷纷被淘汰。。。 还剩下来的，我只支持瑞士嘞，[url=https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/18073668381851882213/4E93208F2D8711D7BA42D38D4748A2F0A4F2A117/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false]就因为这张图[/url](ง •_•)ง 说起来，还有个乐子人好友支持无敌的中国队，因为没有人能在2026年的世界杯上打败中国队！Nobody！！无敌！！！(ง •_•)ง 最后，[b]非常感谢57的礼物٩(๑>◡<๑)۶[/b] P.S.看不懂世界杯也没关系，真能看懂了哪还有功夫边看边玩啊

Many of the incremental games are very satisfying to get in one 2-6h sitting. I don't think that's true for this one since most runs feels very same-same. There's a very low amount of rare cards, and a bunch of "combination" weapons after you've maxed two of the correct ones in the same run. Other than the combos, you'll see everything this game has to offer in just a couple of runs, and the combos are not interesting anyway. The tech-trees offers very little in terms of variety (never any new cards or weapons added to the mix), and you'll soon find that trying out different tree-paths for the same characters is a chore more than anything. Despite only stating negative stuff above, I still think it's a competent game. Graphics and sounds are much better than your average incremental game, gameplay is quite satisfying. It feels polished. You just have to take it bite size chunks. A few runs a day or something. I enjoyed the "Vanilla rat" challenge the most. Maybe more of difficult-ish challenges would have helped this title?
